[SWS_CM_11017] Mapping of Send method
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00201, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00015
⌈
When instructed to send an event message, the DDS Binding shall construct and
send a new sample of the equivalent DDS Topic data type as described in [FO_PRS_
DDS_00102].
⌋
The DDS serialization rules are defined in section 7.2.3.7.
